goal: Read docs/IDEA.md with no history and write docs/BRIEF.md: what this round asks for.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/BRIEF.md has the sections Asked, Deliverable, Done when, Unclear and Not asked
It restates only what docs/IDEA.md says

decisions.what: Scoped the round to the rule-based, offline data-to-dashboard app with no AI or LLM
decisions.why: The idea's final section says the software, not an AI, should do the explaining, with no language model, no text generation and no internet
decisions.evidence: docs/IDEA.md line 107: "No language models, no text generation, no internet connection required."

decisions.what: Listed deliverable as an offline local web app with one-click launch
decisions.why: The idea says clients run it offline and it should start from a single click, like booting an OS
decisions.evidence: docs/IDEA.md line 138: "the entire environment must launch from a single click"

decisions.what: Put the PowerPoint, Excel and Power BI exports under Unclear and Not asked, not Done when
decisions.why: They appear only in the earlier AI-based sections, and the idea later says it wants no narration
